infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SpiceStrong uses speech recognition so you can dictate recipe ideas, ingredients, and cooking preferences into SpiceBuilder.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SpiceStrong uses the camera when you choose to scan food labels, barcodes, menus, receipts, or fridge ingredients. For example, a nutrition label photo is analyzed to estimate macros, and a fridge photo can identify ingredients for recipe suggestions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SpiceStrong uses selected photos when you choose to upload nutrition labels, recipes, menus, receipts, or ingredient photos for AI extraction. For example, a receipt photo can be analyzed to add grocery items to your pantry.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SpiceStrong saves images only when you choose to export or save recipe photos, progress images, or shareable recipe cards to your photo library.
